# mdskills.ai

> > Free AI skills marketplace for Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, and 27+ AI agents supporting SKILL.md, MCP servers, and agent plugins

mdskills.ai is a centralized hub for discovering, sharing, and installing AI agent skills compatible with popular development tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, and ChatGPT. The platform supports multiple skill formats including SKILL.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, AGENTS.md, and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers for code automation and developer productivity.
